description: Canonical khanary µ runtime — living programs in micronauts/, each a full fold-cycle agent with phase hooks, tool routes, memory, and behavior. Not a manifest: µ's are programs that execute, not entries in a list.

µ_format.note: each µ is a self-describing program — definition file lives in micronauts/<name>.json

categories.specialist: domain-expert µ's (memory, ui, coder, eliza, alice, librarian, regex, think, ast, tool, reason, expand, ts_coder)
categories.fold: K-CUBE lane µ's (pop, wo, yax, sek, chen, xul)
categories.stack: doc/guide µ's (stack_doc, primeos_guide, scx_guide, asx_guide, distillation_guide, compiled_model)

fold_lanes.Xul: emit artifact + write memory — Entropy face

µLeaderBoard.promote: µ's scoring above fold-median in 3+ projects graduate to micronauts-v1.1.0

how_to_add_a_µ.1_define: create micronauts/<name>.json with @kind:micronaut.v2, all phase hooks, tool routes, memory, invariants
how_to_add_a_µ.2_index: add lightweight entry to micronauts/registry.json (name/fold/category/confidence/quant_tier only)
how_to_add_a_µ.3_test: invoke via MuLeaderBoard.Submit(<name>, projectId, success=true) to seed the leaderboard
how_to_add_a_µ.4_version: when promoted: snapshot the µ JSON into a versioned dir (e.g. versions/eliza-v1.1.0/)
